system.description:
Cunei Myrgha Inheritance: a business. Uncommon, Salt. No item slots.

Prerequisites: Society:Legalism[1], Economy, Proficiency[3]

You are a dedicated civil servant acquainted with finances

Influential (Ceremony): Every Long Rest that you take in your home city, you must spend at least one Long Rest action working for the Ministry. When you do, choose one effect:
Take Pay: Gain 50gp
Find Clues: You may identify one clue or fact of the local region pertaining to financial matters

Cook Books (Passive): When you are performing your work at the Ministry of Finance, you can cook the books. If you do, gain X*50gp instead of 50gp. You can choose any number for X. When you do, roll XD20. If any number is a natural 1, you are found out. Lose all of your money and this Inheritance.

Rulebook p.45.
